title: Completion, Conversion and Payoff of Construction Loans
content:
Construction Loans end at completion of the project, by conversion into permanent financing or by payoff from other funds.

## Standard

The project is complete when the final inspection (where the product requires a final inspection) finds it 100% in place and, where the product requires a certificate of occupancy, the county certificate of occupancy is received. Within the product's conversion deadline in calendar days after the completed date the loan converts into the product's permanent product — a Country Home loan or a farm real estate loan, opened through the trigger and booked under that line's own charter — or is paid off from other funds; a single-close product converts on the terms set at the construction closing, the others on the permanent product's terms at conversion. Conversion carries the product's conversion fee. A loan neither converted nor paid off by the deadline is referred to a loan officer.

## Completion

| Product requires a final inspection | Product requires a certificate of occupancy | The project is complete when |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | the final inspection finds it 100% in place and the county certificate of occupancy is received |
| Yes | No | the final inspection finds it 100% in place |

The completed date is the date of the final inspection that finds the project complete.

## Status through completion and conversion

- When the final inspection finds the project complete, a loan in active or extended status becomes converting while conversion to permanent financing is prepared.
- When the permanent loan is booked and the construction balance is paid from it, the loan becomes converted. The permanent loan is a Country Home loan of Rural Home Loans or a farm real estate loan of Farm Real Estate Loans, opened for the same member, and the conversion fee is assessed.
- When the construction balance is repaid from other funds, the loan becomes paid off — from active or extended status, or from converting status where the member repays at completion instead of converting.

## Terms of the permanent loan

| Product type | Terms on which it converts |
|---|---|
| Single-close product | The terms set at the construction closing |
| Other products | The permanent product's terms at conversion |

## Points of judgement

- *What follows if the deadline passes with neither conversion nor payoff?* The loan is referred to a loan officer.
- *Into which line does the loan convert?* Into the product's permanent product, a Country Home loan or a farm real estate loan, booked under that line's own charter.
